# 06-comments

Valid format 4 build. Four comments, one of each kind, and a discussion block that lists them.

A correct reader shows the discussion block in the Overview view with four comments.

- Comment 101 is an inline comment on `pkg/store.py`, head side, lines 15 to 16. It is current.
- Comment 102 is an inline comment on `pkg/store.py`, base side, with no line range. The reader keeps only the file name. It is marked outdated.
- Comment 201 is a review with the state "changes requested". The reader shows the state with the review text.
- Comment 301 is an issue comment on the conversation. It has no file and no line.
- Each comment shows its author, its time, its body, and a link to its URL on GitHub.
